name: Sendit Israel
author: upsystem

sections.description:
Sendit Israel provides an easy way to send SMS notifications from WordPress and WooCommerce.
The plugin sends SMS updates for WooCommerce order status changes and allows sending SMS through Contact Form 7 submissions using your Sendit API token.

Features

  • SMS notifications for WooCommerce order status changes
  • Contact Form 7 SMS integration
  • Uses your Sendit API token and sender name
  • Simple and lightweight

External services

This plugin connects to the Sendit SMS platform (Sendit Israel) in order to send SMS messages and track related events.

When you use this plugin, the following data may be sent to the Sendit API (https://sendit.co.il):
– Your Sendit API token (for authenticating the requests).
– Recipient phone number(s).
– SMS message content and sender name.
– Technical event data (such as delivery status, message ID, and related metadata) when events are reported back to WordPress.

This data is required in order to:
– Send SMS messages from your WordPress site using your Sendit account.
– Record and update message-related events (such as delivery events) in your WordPress installation.

The external service used by this plugin is:
– Sendit SMS Platform (Sendit Israel) – a third-party service that requires an active Sendit account in order to use this plugin.

For more information about how data is handled, please review Sendit’s Privacy Policy:
https://sendit.co.il/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP to WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Settings → Sendit Israel.
  4. Enter your Sendit API token and sender name.
